messages.Попробуйте другой запрос или сбросьте фи: Try another search or reset the filters.
messages.Попробуйте разные решения и узнайте, что: Try different decisions and discover their consequences.
messages.Предварительная рекомендация по счётчика: A preliminary recommendation based on counts of your latest learning decisions. Skills are linked to stories, so this estimate is less precise than the assessment.
messages.Прекратите демонстрацию экрана и выдачу: Stop screen sharing and granting permissions. Do not open banking apps or enter passwords on a device that someone else may have accessed.
messages.Прекратите дополнительные платежи за обе: Stop making additional payments for a promised guaranteed result. Keep the terms, advertisements, receipts and correspondence.
messages.Прекратите новые переводы. Не оплачивайт: Stop making transfers. Do not pay for a “refund”, “unblocking” or a promise to close an investigation.
messages.Прекратите передачу кодов, паролей, токе: Stop sharing codes, passwords and tokens or granting further permissions.
messages.При непосредственной угрозе жизни или зд: If life or health is in immediate danger, contact the relevant emergency services. This guide does not replace official help, block cards or confirm that harm has been resolved.
messages.При угрозах получите поддержку доверенно: If you are threatened, seek support from someone you trust and contact the police. If account or banking access was exposed, secure it separately through the official service or bank.
messages.При участии счёта или кредита немедленно: If a bank account or loan is involved, contact your bank immediately through an official channel. Do not try to recover losses by sending more money or using force; keep documents and contact the police if there are signs of theft.
messages.Привет! Выручишь?: Hi! Could you help me out?
messages.Проверка или решение требуют внимания: Verification or your decision needs attention
messages.Проверьте действия в аккаунте и предупре: Check account activity and warn the people affected. If banking access was exposed or money was sent, contact your bank immediately as well.
messages.Проверьте подключение и обновите страниц: Check your connection and reload the page. For an offline lesson, open the required materials in advance. Other practice remains available.
messages.Проверьте сам вопрос через независимо от: Check the underlying issue through an official channel opened independently: a suspicious message does not cancel a real payment or obligation.
messages.Проверьте фактическое поступление и полн: Verify actual receipt of full payment, the parties’ authority and the handover terms. A screenshot, courier’s receipt or promise does not confirm payment.
messages.Проверьте, какие договоры, полномочия и: Check which contracts, authorisations and obligations already exist. If a contract has been signed or property handed over, document the facts and seek independent legal advice.
messages.Проверяем прямые просьбы и косвенные сиг: We check direct requests and indirect signals: money “until tomorrow”, digits from a call, fake payouts, QR sign-ins and pressure. The text stays on your device.
messages.Проверяйте домен назначения, а не назван: Check the destination domain, not the bank name elsewhere in the link.
messages.Проверяйте каждую букву и основной домен: Check every letter and the main domain; similar-looking characters may belong to different alphabets.
messages.Проверяйте полный адрес и самостоятельно: Check the full address and open the service independently.
messages.Пройдите первую ситуацию и изучите разбо: Try your first situation and read the debrief.
messages.Пройдите связанные истории в своём темпе: Work through related stories at your own pace, then bring what you have learnt together. The quiz at the end is entirely optional.
messages.Путь похож на загрузку исполняемого файл: The path resembles a download for an executable file, app or device profile.
messages.Пять историй для выбранных навыков. Это: Five stories for your chosen skills. This is a recommendation, not a judgement of you as a person; you can open any other practice at any time.
messages.Разбираем адрес на устройстве. Не открыв: We analyse the address on your device. We do not open websites, send images or execute QR code content.
The image resolution is too high. Choose a smaller copy.
messages.Расскажите чуть подробнее — нужно не мен: Tell us a little more — at least 80 characters: what happened, what you were asked to do and how it ended.
messages.Расскажите, с какой ситуацией столкнулис: Tell us about a situation you encountered. The CyberShield team will review your story and may turn it into a new learning scenario.
messages.Результат не относится к этому занятию: The result does not belong to this lesson
messages.Результат не соответствует очереди подбо: The result does not match the collection’s sequence
messages.Результаты разных занятий не объединяютс: Results from different lessons are not combined into one score. These are client-side learning summaries, not a secure exam or proof of the number of unique participants.
messages.С доверенного устройства защитите аккаун: Use a trusted device to secure your account, end unfamiliar sessions and revoke exposed API keys or permissions through the service’s official tools. Do not share your wallet recovery phrase.
messages.С другого доверенного устройства защитит: Secure affected accounts from another trusted device. Contact official support or a trusted specialist to restore the device; keep proof of ownership.
messages.С какой ситуации начнём?: Which situation shall we start with?
messages.Сайт не открывался. Не вводите данные и: The website was not opened. Do not enter data or pay based only on this check.
messages.Самостоятельно откройте привычное прилож: Open your usual app or an official channel independently. A similar name does not prove ownership.
messages.Сверьте вложенный домен. Не открывайте с: Check the embedded domain. Do not open the link to check it; the actual redirect chain was not loaded here.
messages.Сверьте именно основной домен, а не знак: Check the main domain itself, not a familiar word at the start of the address.
messages.Сверьте назначение, условия, сумму, срок: Check the purpose, terms, amount, deadline and recipient. If you already approved a subscription or payment, check the consequences and cancellation process with the relevant service or bank.
messages.Сверьте отправителя, полномочия, назначе: Check the sender, authority, purpose of the request and recipient. Even neutral text can be part of a longer chain.
messages.Сверяйте реальное имя сайта, не запускай: Check the actual website name; do not open the reconstructed link automatically.
messages.Сделайте паузу. Не переводите деньги, не: Pause. Do not transfer money, disclose secrets or follow instructions until you have verified the request independently.
messages.Сервис FormSubmit подтвердил приём заявк: FormSubmit confirmed receipt of the submission for forwarding to the team. Thank you for contributing to CyberShield. Publication is not guaranteed: the story must first be reviewed and adapted for learning.
messages.Сервис не подтвердил приём заявки. Истор: The service did not confirm receipt. Your story is still on screen — try again later.
messages.Сервис отправки сейчас недоступен. Истор: The submission service is currently unavailable. Your story is still on screen — try again later.
messages.Сервис просит подтвердить адрес получате: The service requires confirmation of the recipient’s address. The team needs to activate the form using the FormSubmit email. Delivery of your story is not yet confirmed; the text remains on screen.
messages.Смотрите на настоящее имя сайта ниже. Не: Look at the actual website name below. Do not enter data based on the text before @.
messages.Сначала входной тест, затем практика и д: First take an initial test, then practise and take a different final test of comparable difficulty. The A→B or B→A order is chosen randomly on your device. Correct answers are not shown during the test.
messages.Сначала выберите навык или пройдите диаг: Choose a skill or take the assessment first
messages.Содержимое QR слишком длинное. Оно не вы: The QR content is too long. It was not executed.
messages.Сокращатель скрывает конечный адрес. Про: A shortener hides the final address. This check did not follow the link or reveal its destination.
messages.Сообщение от друга, звонок из банка или: A message from a friend, a call from the bank or an SMS about a parcel.
messages.Сообщить об ошибке без личных данных: Report an error without personal data
messages.Сохраните идентификаторы операций и пере: Keep transaction identifiers and correspondence. Contact the service’s official support and the police if theft occurred; notify your bank too if you paid through it. A confirmed blockchain transfer usually cannot be reversed, and no guaranteed recovery can be promised.
messages.Сохраните сообщения, реквизиты и подтвер: Keep messages, payment details and payment confirmations. Contact the police if theft occurred; for an immediate threat, call 102.
messages.Сохраните уведомления и переписку. Если: Keep notifications and correspondence. If there are unauthorised debits, notify your bank and contact the police. Deleting the chat does not protect exposed data.
Keep the terms and verification results. Closing a page does not confirm cancellation of a transaction or fulfilment of an obligation.
messages.Сохраняем только результат и дату в этом: Only the result and date are saved in this browser. Conversation texts are not saved.
messages.Спокойствие начинается с практики: Peace of mind starts with practice
messages.Сравните разобранное имя сайта ниже; не: Compare the parsed website name below; do not rely on the original caption.
messages.Срочность и просьба сохранить всё в тайн: Urgency and a demand for secrecy are reasons to stop. You can end the conversation or delay your reply.
messages.Ссылка вместе с запросом данных, выплато: A link combined with a data request, payout or alarming notification
messages.Ссылка на программу или профиль: Link to an app or profile
messages.Ссылка останется на устройстве. Пароли,: The link stays on your device. Passwords, personal tokens and QR content are not published.
messages.Ссылки не распознаны. Перепишите адрес в: No links recognised. Enter the address manually and check every character.
messages.Такие решения могут казаться естественны: These decisions may feel natural. It helps to notice them before the next situation.
Just the story. No personal data.
messages.Три коротких вопроса для обсуждения. Мож: Three short discussion questions. You may skip or stop the quiz; it does not limit access to practice.
messages.Увеличенный текст и кнопки, чёткие грани: Larger text and buttons, clear borders, high contrast and a simplified layout.
messages.Удалите код или пароль. Напишите просто: Remove the code or password. Simply write “SMS code” or “password”.
messages.Удалите похожий на телефон, реквизиты ил: Remove the number that resembles a phone number, financial details or document number.
messages.Удалите сам код или пароль. Оставьте тол: Remove the code or password itself. Leave only the words “SMS code” or “password”.
messages.Удалите ссылки и имена аккаунтов. Достат: Remove links and account names. The service name is enough: for example, Telegram or Belpost.
messages.Удалить ответы основной и повторной диаг: Delete initial and follow-up assessment answers on this device? Scenario and collection progress will remain.
messages.Удалить план и новые счётчики рекомендац: Delete the plan and new recommendation counters? Assessments, old progress and collections will remain.
messages.Учебная памятка. Она не гарантирует возв: Educational guide. It does not guarantee recovery of funds or replace help from your bank or law enforcement.
messages.Учимся проверять, а не подозревать всех: Learn to verify, not to suspect everyone
messages.Учитесь распознавать обман в ситуациях,: Learn to recognise deception in situations familiar to everyone.
messages.Файл содержит только ID занятия, счётчик: The file contains only the lesson ID, counts and skill scores. Share it with the teacher only if you choose to; it contains no name, conversation or permanent device ID.
messages.Фрагмент адреса может использоваться стр: The address fragment may be used for page navigation or hide additional data.
messages.Хотите проверить, что запомнилось?: Want to check what you remember?
messages.Часть до @ — не имя сайта назначения. Та: The part before @ is not the destination website’s name. It may contain a bank name or secret data.
messages.Чего не хватило для проверки:: What was missing from the verification:
Than be caught off guard in real life.
messages.Через самостоятельно открытое приложение: Open the app or official website independently to end unfamiliar sessions, change the exposed password and revoke unnecessary permissions or keys. Enable two-step protection if available.
messages.Черновик → факты и ссылки → методическая: Draft → facts and links → teaching review → independent expert review where available → publication. Help guides are revision 1; the message analyser is revision 2. Materials await independent expert review for Belarus. They carry no “expert-verified” badges.
messages.Числовой адрес не подтверждает связь с б: A numeric address does not prove any connection to a bank or organisation. Browsers convert some unusual formats into IP addresses.
messages.Что делать после такой ошибки: What to do after this mistake
messages.Что делать, если это произошло в жизни: What to do if this happened in real life
messages.Что заметить и как действовать дальше: What to notice and how to act next
messages.Что объединяет эти ситуации: What these situations have in common

messages.из 5. Повтор одной истории заменяет её и: of 5. Retrying a story replaces its result; stopping before an ending does not count.
messages.историй с последствиями или неполной про: stories with consequences or incomplete verification

messages.SMS было поддельным. Данные остались у в: The SMS was fake. Your data stayed with you. A familiar delivery topic does not by itself prove a message is genuine.
messages.«Выручишь до завтра?»: “Could you lend me some money until tomorrow?”
messages.«Есть минутка помочь?»: “Have you got a minute to help?”
messages.Андрей узнал о постороннем доступе к акк: Andrey learnt that someone else had accessed his account. You kept your money and helped stop further requests in his name.
In the simulation, the money went to a stranger. Nothing is charged here. Pressure and a familiar profile can mislead anyone — let’s see where you could have paused.
messages.В симуляции произошла потеря денег. Если: Money was lost in the simulation. If this happened in real life, contact your bank immediately through an official channel and keep the transaction details for a police report.
messages.В учебной истории сотрудник подтвердил:: In this learning story, an employee confirmed that no extra payment was needed. The SMS was sent by outsiders.
messages.В этой истории вы помогли знакомой. Одна: In this story you helped someone you know. But a good outcome does not make transferring money without checking a reliable habit.
messages.В этот раз просьба настоящая, но привычк: This time the request is genuine, but transferring money without checking creates a future risk.
messages.Вам пишет близкий человек. Проверьте обс: Someone close to you sends a message. Check the circumstances and decide what to do.
messages.Ваша посылка задержана. Уточните адрес и: Your parcel is delayed. Confirm your address and pay for redelivery: 2.40 BYN. Link: [practice link].
messages.Вечер. Вам пишет знакомый, с которым вы: It’s evening. Someone you have known for a long time messages you on Viber.
messages.Вы вправе отказать без оправданий, даже: You have the right to refuse without explaining yourself, even if the request turns out to be genuine.
messages.Вы выбрали личную встречу: You chose to meet in person
messages.Вы выбрали независимый источник вместо а: You chose an independent source instead of the address in the message.
messages.Вы выбрали независимый канал. Настоящий: You chose an independent channel. The real Andrey confirmed that he had not asked for money.
messages.Вы выбрали проверку через отделение: You chose to check at the branch
messages.Вы ждёте заказ. Приходит SMS от отправит: You’re waiting for an order. An SMS arrives from “Delivery”. The link in this simulation does not open external websites.
messages.Вы защитили себя и предупредили друга: You protected yourself and warned your friend
messages.Вы не обязаны давать деньги в долг. Это: You are not obliged to lend money. Refusing is valid whether or not the request is genuine.
messages.Вы не перевели деньги и помогли знакомом: You did not transfer money and helped your friend discover the hack.
messages.Вы оставили себе время на проверку: You gave yourself time to check
messages.Вы остановились до передачи данных. Код: You stopped before sharing data. An SMS code may authorise a transaction, not a delivery.
messages.Вы открыли сервис отслеживания самостоят: You opened the tracking service independently. The parcel is on its way and no extra charges are listed.
messages.Вы проверили сведения и сообщили о попыт: You checked the information and reported the attempted fraud.
messages.Вы проверяете просьбу через другой, ране: You verify the request through another channel you already knew.
messages.Вы сами набрали сохранённый номер. Марин: You dialled the saved number yourself. Marina answered, calmly discussed the situation and offered to meet. “Yes, I sent that message. We can go to the shop together.”
messages.Выйду из чата и всё равно наберу знакомы: I’ll leave the chat and call the number I know anyway.
messages.Готовность перевести деньги до проверки: Willingness to transfer money before checking increases the risk. Familiar names and photos can be copied.
Yes, I’ll transfer it right away.
messages.Давай на карту другого человека, моя сей: Send it to someone else’s card; mine is blocked at the moment. Please hurry.
messages.Давай созвонимся по твоему обычному номе: Let’s talk on your usual number.
messages.Даже проверенная просьба не отменяет ваш: Even a verified request does not override your financial boundaries.
messages.Данные карты и защитный код уже чувствит: Card details and the security code are already sensitive information. Not sharing an SMS code does not rule out unauthorised charges.
messages.Деньги остались у вас. В этой учебной си: You kept your money. In this learning situation the sender was an attacker. In real life, a pause alone does not prove fraud — contact your friend another way.
I’ll send a small amount first.
messages.Днём приходит сообщение от знакомой. Вы: During the day, someone you know messages you. You sometimes chat and meet up.
messages.Закрою страницу и проверю доставку самос: I’ll close the page and check the delivery independently.
messages.Звонок по ранее сохранённому номеру помо: Calling a previously saved number helps you verify identity independently of the conversation.
messages.Знакомое фото. Обычная просьба. Как поня: A familiar photo. An everyday request. How can you tell who is really behind the screen?
messages.Код подтвердил чужую операцию: The code authorised someone else’s transaction
Of course, send the payment details.
messages.Личная встреча — ещё один разумный спосо: Meeting in person is another sensible way to help and understand the circumstances.
messages.Лучше встретимся и вместе обсудим покупк: Let’s meet and discuss the purchase together instead.
messages.Маленькая доплата может скрывать сбор пл: A small extra charge can conceal an attempt to collect payment details.
messages.Марина действительно просила о помощи. В: Marina really did ask for help. Meeting let you discuss the situation without rushing.
messages.На всякий случай заплачу — сумма маленьк: I’ll pay just in case — it’s only a small amount.
messages.На учебной странице запрашиваются номер: The practice page asks for your card number, expiry date, security code and SMS code. “To confirm delivery.”
messages.На чужую карту не перевожу. Сначала позв: I won’t transfer to someone else’s card. I’ll call you first.
messages.Напомни, где мы виделись в последний раз: Remind me where we last met?
messages.Не буду отвечать. Уточню статус в отделе: I won’t reply. I’ll check the status at the branch.
messages.Не звони, я сейчас не могу говорить. Про: Don’t call, I can’t talk right now. Just transfer it, please, it’s urgent.
Not every request for money is a scam.
messages.Не сообщайте коды из SMS собеседникам; п: Do not share SMS codes with people contacting you; check what the transaction is for.
messages.Небольшая сумма может отвлекать от главн: A small amount can distract from the real goal: obtaining card details and a confirmation code.
messages.Небольшой перевод не проверяет получател: A small transfer does not verify the recipient. Even a small amount can be lost.
messages.Независимая проверка состоялась. Теперь: You have verified independently. Whether to help is now your decision.
messages.Неожиданный получатель — дополнительный: An unexpected recipient is another reason to stop. On his known number, Andrey denied making the request.
messages.Обсудим срок возврата и удобный способ п: Let’s agree on when you’ll pay it back and a convenient way to help.
messages.Остановлю переписку и предупрежу знакомо: I’ll stop the chat and warn my friend another way.
messages.Ответы о встречах могут быть в украденно: Answers about meetings may be in stolen conversations. This question does not replace independent verification.
messages.Отказ от проверки под давлением — момент: Abandoning verification under pressure is the moment an attacker is counting on.
I’ll open the link and see what they ask for.
messages.Пауза сохраняет контроль над решением. С: Pausing keeps you in control of your decision. Urgency does not oblige you to transfer money.
messages.Перевод ушёл без проверки получателя: The transfer went through without checking the recipient
messages.Передам данные карты, но код из SMS оста: I’ll share my card details but keep the SMS code to myself.
messages.Передача данных карты и кода может позво: Sharing card details and a code can authorise someone else’s transaction. Always read what the code is for.
messages.По сохранённому номеру ответил настоящий: The real Andrey answered on the saved number: he had not asked for money. In this situation, someone else had used his account.
messages.Подожду, пока сможем поговорить. Пока не: I’ll wait until we can talk. No transfer for now.
messages.Подтвержу все данные, чтобы получить пос: I’ll confirm all the details to receive the parcel.
I’ll call you on the number I saved.
messages.После независимой проверки у вас нет осн: After checking independently, you have no reason to follow the SMS demand.
messages.После проверки вы уточнили условия. Подл: After checking, you clarified the terms. Even a genuine request does not guarantee repayment.
messages.После проверки можно помочь, предложить: After checking, you can help, suggest another option or refuse.
messages.Привет! Можешь одолжить 150 рублей до за: Hi! Could you lend me 150 Belarusian rubles until tomorrow? I really need it; I’ll explain later.
messages.Привет! У меня неожиданно сломался холод: Hi! My fridge broke down unexpectedly. Could you lend me 200 Belarusian rubles until Friday? If it’s not convenient, I understand.
messages.Проверка личности важнее правдоподобия о: Verifying identity matters more than a plausible explanation.
messages.Проверка через отделение позволяет разоб: Checking at the branch lets you clarify matters without sharing data with the SMS sender.
messages.Проверю заказ в приложении или на сайте: I’ll check the order in the service’s app or website, opening it independently.
messages.Проверяйте доставку через сервис, которы: Check deliveries through a service you opened independently.
messages.Проверяйте обстоятельства, а не только о: Check the circumstances, not just individual “suspicious” words.
messages.Проверяйте просьбу через ранее известный: Verify the request through a communication channel you already know.
messages.Просьба была настоящей. Отказать в займе: The request was genuine. You may decline to lend money: being cautious does not require accusing someone of fraud.
messages.Просьба настоящая, но проверка пропущена: Genuine request, but verification was skipped
messages.Само открытие ссылки ещё не означает пот: Opening a link alone does not mean losing money, but it may lead to a fake page.
I’m not ready to lend money right now, sorry.
